name: Bodyguard for Hire
summary: In Desolace, Cork Gizelton and Rigger stop their kodo caravan at the sound of centaur war drums. Cork asks you to guard it past the Kolkar village, with payment waiting down the road.

sections.title: War Drums
sections.body: Cork Gizelton and Rigger lead their kodo caravan past the Kolkar centaur. Then the war drums sound, and the caravan stops. Dead traders bring no profit, so Cork asks you to guard it a short distance past the Kolkar village and keep it safe. The caravan waits north of the Kolkar Village and southeast of Thunder Axe Fortress.

sections.title: Smeed Scrabblescrew
sections.body: Smeed Scrabblescrew waits with payment at Scrabblescrew's Camp, a little way down the road. Smeed does a little business with the Gizelton caravan.

faq.answer: Cork Gizelton leads a kodo caravan through Desolace with Rigger. They stop whenever the centaur war drums sound.

faq.q: Why does the caravan need protection?
faq.answer: The caravan needs protection because Cork and Rigger stop whenever the centaur war drums sound. Dead traders bring no profit.
The escort starts north of the Kolkar Village and southeast of Thunder Axe Fortress.
Payment waits with Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp, a little way down the road. Smeed does a little business with Cork.
